- 2026-09-21T11:14:42.454Z — chose **3.1 judges each logged decision against its own initiative's live rejected approaches (A2) and standing rules (A3). That covers both sofar_log_decision and end_session's batched decisions. The judge runs after the append and only adds warnings. Candidates are BM25-ranked by the index's ranker (core/lexicon), topped up with the newest, 8 per kind. Unacknowledged candidates only: a draft that supersedes D<n> or cites it in `because` is not judged against D<n>. The free-path rule decides only near-verbatim re-proposals, meaning 3+ shared distinguishing terms that make up at least 2/3 of the smaller set, and leaves contradiction to the model. The warn threshold is provisional at p ≥ 0.9 and unmeasured. Cross-initiative contradiction is deferred until the index carries rule text.** over Judging cross-initiative standing constraints in 3.1. The reach index holds only clipped decision labels, with no rule and no retirement, so it would take extra folds of other initiatives on every decision write. Also rejected: a lexical rule that decides re-proposal on any overlap, because shared domain words would produce confidence-1 false positives that the model could never correct. because The digest tells the agent to obey exactly its own initiative's standing constraints and rejected approaches, so that is where a silent violation costs most (bench C3). A rule answer is final and never forwarded, so the lexical rule must only claim what lexical evidence proves. Measured: two decisions about the same engine share "typesafe" and "engine" without re-proposing each other. The 1.1 calibration has no re-proposal ground truth, so the threshold stays provisional until 6.1 grades it.

- 2026-09-22T07:47:32.243Z — rule: **Stored relevance only ranks and adds: never drop a guard, derived-scope or lexically linked candidate on a low p, and never return a superseded or until-retired decision from a relevance row.** — chose **5.1 and memory-lead B1 share one stored-relevance contract, agreed with sofar-6e on 2026-09-22. The row is judgement_recorded {producer:"sofar-cloud", model, question:"relevance", subject, about, answer:{type:"noul", noul}, state_hash}. `subject` is qualified per the citation grammar: a bare `D12` means the envelope's initiative; any other record's handle is `<slug> D12` or `<slug> M3`. `about` is a NEW typed optional field: "task:<id>" or "file:<repo-relative path>". 5.1 lands it in packages/schema with the fingerprint bump and the rust-core mirror, together with its first writer; B1 makes no schema change. There is one index-only reader, relevance(about) → [{subject, p, model}], inside the hook budget. It never returns a retired or voided decision (superseded, or `until` resolved; r1-fixes D25), whatever its stored p. p ≤ 0.2 drops only a candidate the judge ADDED. A guard or derived-scope match is never removed, only ranked. B1's candidates stay deterministic: `path:` guards plus paths the decision's text names. Session co-touch is out. A typed field is validated where a string key is not. Retired decisions must stay retired, or an old high-p row resurfaces a reversed rule.
